title: Third moment bound for multilinear polynomials
statement:
Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $F$ be a real coefficient family on the subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ whose coefficients vanish on sets of size greater than $k$. Suppose the random variables $X_i:\Omega\to\bbr$ are independent, and for some $0<\rho<1$ each $X_i$ is $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive, has mean zero, and has second moment one. Then
\[
\int_\Omega |F(X)(\omega)|^3\,d\mu(\omega)
\le \left(\frac{1}{\rho}\right)^{3k}
\left(\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}} F(S)^2\right)^{3/2},
\]
where $F(X)$ is the random-input multilinear evaluation of $F$.
